summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its routine monthly total voting rights and capital statement under FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1, the UK equivalent of a routine share-capital confirmation. As of 30 September 2026, issued share capital comprised 877,750,024 ordinary shares of US20 cents each, including 40,317,488 shares held in treasury, leaving 837,432,536 shares with voting rights. No transaction, price, stake, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanic is involved; shareholders should use the 837,432,536 figure as the denominator for interest notifications. No risk-arb angle applies.
